app.name: Inference Gateway
app.one_liner: An open-source, cloud-native proxy that unifies access to multiple LLM providers through a consistent OpenAI-compatible API.

screens.name: Gateway Dashboard
screens.purpose: Display active providers, MCP tool status, and request metrics for monitoring and control.

rust_commands.name: route_inference_request
rust_commands.purpose: Forward an inference request to the appropriate LLM provider based on configuration and model selection.

mvp_plan: week 1: Add MCP tool discovery and injection middleware
week 1: Implement core proxy routing for OpenAI and Ollama
week 1: Support basic streaming response handling
acceptance_tests: Gateway successfully proxies a /chat/completions request to OpenAI and returns a non-streaming response.
When MCP_ENABLE=true, tools from connected MCP servers are automatically injected into LLM requests.
With ENABLE_VISION=true, image inputs in requests are processed by vision-capable models like GPT-4o.
